commenti.body:
I thought the film was an extremely fun teen satire, however, i do think the film falls into its own trap and fails to fully capitalize on its own premise.

The film ostensibly wants to be a parody of teen comedies. It lampoons the genre to extremes and plays with the classic archetypes as you say.

But the movie also wants to be a sincere attempt at placing lesbians at the centerstage, and still tries to keep focus on the central friend conflict that we have seen in all the teen comedies it is trying to satirize.

In essence, it wants to have its cake and eat it too. It wants to make fun of all the teen comedies that came before while falling victim to the tropes it is trying to make fun of.

And so though I had an absolute blast at times, I couldnt help but feel a little wanting. I think this is most heavily illustrated through the character of hazel. Hazel gets done dirty by both story devices. She is too over-the-top for the sincere high school rom-com, but too intimately detailed for the outrageous parody. She seems stuck in the middle where she doesnt get enough screen time or development to feel like anything more than a tertiary character, but she is one of the movers and shakers of the plot.= that deserves more understanding.

Compared to two all time teen comedy classics that more confidently stick to their respective genres - Better Off Dead and Superbad - I think Bottoms fails to really strike the right balance and never makes its way to bonafide hit. But my god it is a breath of fresh air in a sea of mediocre comedies that I really couldnt care. Marshawn Lynch was hysterical and some of the background details had me rolling.

I totally agree with you about the character of Hazel, she definitely stood out but was not classed as one of the protagonist, I feel with her is where the film tried to have their cake and eat it too. Her motivations and decisions made the film unique. I was surprised with myself on how much i enjoyed the film, i have been avoiding teen comedies lately and i'm glad that i did not avoid this one.
